provenance.method: Representation Router planning-review principles, source-bound recommendation; not a tool-generated score or visual certification

question: Can Brian see what the person tried, how it was interpreted, what the world did, and whether evidence is complete?
rationale: One selected event links original words, reading, world result and evidence. Same-moment chains need causal order, while skill and replay require side-by-side recorded values.

compositionPlan.primary_element: Selected attempt with original words, interpretation and consequence
secondary_elements: Exact trace links and missing-evidence labels
compositionPlan.interaction: Read-only shared event selection; no rerun or model call implied by inspection.
compositionPlan.color: Blue for selection, orange for gaps/refusals, grey for context; explicit text labels.

availability: partial: retained records and some run views exist; the complete combined inspector and S3 demonstrations are planned
alternatives: A table alone supports comparison but loses causal sequence.
A graph alone hides exact words and values; use it only as a linked secondary view.
avoid: A test-count badge as proof of behavior
Treating a narration as the missing trace
Marking partial fixture evidence as full generated-world success
verification: Recommendation only; no render or user-judgment certification performed.
